title: Hontiveros, Alan Cayetano attend National Prayer Breakfast
summary: Senator Risa Hontiveros and Senator Alan Peter Cayetano on Wednesday attended the 51st National Prayer Breakfast as guests of honor.

blocks.text: Senator Risa Hontiveros and Senator Alan Peter Cayetano on Wednesday attended the 51st National Prayer Breakfast as guests of honor.
This year's theme is centered on "United in prayer, Healing our land."
During the event, Cayetano spoke about the problems currently facing the country, from political to economic, but acknowledged the power of prayer during this difficult time.

"Praying together with people you don't agree with, especially if it's people you don't like, is a good step forward kasi nawala yung national consensus. Parang nangyari ngayon palakasan na lang ng boses. We have to listen to each other. I really truly believe God will listen to us, but is also telling us to listen to each other," Cayetano said.
Hontiveros, meanwhile, urged the public to continue praying for them amid these challenges.

"There is something deeply comforting about knowing that in the midst of everything happening in our country there are people who take the time to pray for us... Kailangan po talaga namin, kaya pag patuloy po ninyo," Hontiveros said.
(We really need it, please continue praying.)
Hontiveros and Cayetano each received a Bible and were blessed with prayers from the community.
Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian also sent his message of support through a video message.
"As we seek God's wisdom may we find strength to serve with humility, act with integrity and lead with compassion," Gatchalian said.

Senator Bong Go also sent a video message saying that "prayer reminds us of the importance of humility, compassion and service to others, regardless of our different backgrounds and beliefs, to share a common hope for a peaceful, united and better Philippines."
Also in attendance were former chief justice Reynato Puno, Retired Associate Justice Raoul Victorino and Associate Justice Jhosep Lopez.

"Pray for our nation, pray as one, pray in harmony, pray as Filipinos for God's supernatural intervention, for wisdom, for integrity, for righteousness to guide the leaders of government, for our business leaders to have a heart for the poor. For our religious leaders to lift us to the high moral ground and for our people not to abandon hope for we have a God who is omniscient, omnipresent and omnipotent," Puno said. —VAL, GMA News
